method: Actually opened official/author/PMLR pages using web tool; scope recorded below

sources.title: Elkan 2001
sources.verified_scope: PDF pp.1-4 prose: expected action cost, binary threshold, base-rate change; extracted formulas had missing symbols, so derivations were checked independently rather than copied

sources.title: Guo et al. 2017
sources.verified_scope: PDF section4.2 p6, positive common temperature, validation NLL and argmax invariance; section5 caveats

sources.title: Lipton et al. 2018
sources.verified_scope: Primary PMLR abstract: label marginal changes while X conditional on Y does not; BBSE not implemented

sources.title: Roelofs et al. 2022
sources.verified_scope: Primary PDF: binned ECE formula, finite sample bias and bin-count dependence

sources.title: Vaicenavicius et al. 2019
sources.verified_scope: Primary PDF: calibration conditional probability framework and differences between notions

sources.title: PyTorch 2.7 BCEWithLogitsLoss
sources.verified_scope: Logit stability, positive-term weights, element-count mean; actual 2.7.1 CPU numeric check

sources.title: PyTorch 2.7 CrossEntropyLoss
sources.verified_scope: Class-index weighted mean denominator; probability-target formula distinction

limitations: Not a replication of cited papers datasets or neural benchmarks
No BBSE or bias-corrected ECE estimator implementation
